title: SimAI with custom collective schedules: artifact for "MCCL: Measurement-based Collective Communication Library" (CoNEXT 2026)
description:
Artifact for the CoNEXT 2026 paper MCCL: Measurement-based Collective Communication Library (Proc. ACM Netw. 4, CoNEXT4, Article 55, DOI 10.1145/3856969).

A fork of Alibaba Cloud SimAI (ns-3 backend) extended to execute custom collective communication schedules written in the MSCCL XML format (NcclCustom / mscclCustomFlow), used in the paper to evaluate AllGather and AllToAll schedules and LLM training under gray failures. It includes NCCL-equivalent MSCCL schedules, rail-optimized HPN topologies with the paper's three failure profiles, single-collective workloads, a DeepSeek-671B training workload, an MSCCL-vs-native equivalence test, reference outputs, and scripts to run and summarize the experiments. The archive contains all git submodules at the pinned commits. See ARTIFACT.md.
